title: A linear algebraic proof of the Laplacian spread conjecture
summary: For a graph $G,$ let $α(G)$ denote its second smallest Laplacian eigenvalue. The Laplacian Spread Conjecture is that $α(G)+α(\overline{G}) \geq 1,$ where $\overline{G}$ is the complement of $G.$ In this article, we provide a new proof of the Laplacian spread conjecture by means of linear algebra, which is more concise.
